description.value: Ocean Goose is a Japanese restaurant on Vancouver's West 4th Avenue in Kitsilano, serving a broad menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, teriyaki, and other Japanese classics. The restaurant aims for an upscale yet relaxed dining experience and offers both online ordering and table reservations through its website. It sits along a well-travelled cycling corridor, making it a convenient meal stop for cyclists exploring the Kitsilano area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and confirms the OSM address (1850 W 4th Ave, Vancouver, BC V6J 1M3) and URL. The website provides two phone numbers not in OSM. Online ordering and table reservations are offered via the website ('Order Now', 'See MENU & Order'), supporting a takeout value=true. The site mentions a private vehicle parking lot but makes no mention of bike racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null per evidence-only rules.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; two phone numbers (604-229-8447 / 604-229-3673) sourced from website only.
Website copyright footer reads 'luckyhan.ca' rather than 'oceangoose.ca', suggesting a third-party site builder — content appears legitimate but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Japanese restaurant on a busy Vancouver cycling corridor with an operational website, confirmed address, and online ordering. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists.
